introHtml: Custom fishing carabiners are built to hold up in wet, salty environments where standard carabiners would rust or fail. Made from corrosion-resistant stainless steel or heavy-duty aluminum, these carabiners clip keys, tools, or fish stringers to a belt loop or tackle bag. Many models include a built-in bottle opener or a lanyard hole for extra utility. They are popular for fishing tournaments, boat giveaways, and outdoor brand promotions.
